[EN] Do you hear that? It's doubt, and it's calling your name...
[ES] ¿Escuchas eso? Es la duda, y está llamando tu nombre...

[EN] Frustrating, isn't it?
There's always another weakling, expecting you to make the difficult choices.
But what do you get in return?[Look into your memory.]"I'm ready to face my Skepticism.""I'm not ready yet."
[ES] Es frustrante, ¿no?
Siempre hay otro debilucho que espera que tú tomes las decisiones difíciles.
Pero ¿qué obtienes a cambio?[Look into your memory.]"I'm ready to face my Skepticism.""I'm not ready yet."
